title: Learn newsletter senders from owner choices
goal: Stop asking about senders the owner has repeatedly marked as newsletters.
summary: Pods gives a network member read access to its network's owner choices. Categorisation routes a sender to the newsletter batch after two consistent newsletter choices; any other choice cancels the rule. Archiving still needs the IdP approval.

problem.statement: Categorisation never sees the owner's gate choices, so the same senders are asked about again and again (117 newsletter choices for 35 senders).
problem.impact: The owner repeats the same decision many times, and the decision list stays noisy.
problem.approach: Add a read-only network port for owner choices and derive per-sender rules in Categorisation; declared feedback is not allowed with routing gates.
problem.outcome: Mail from learned senders goes straight to the newsletter batch; the owner only confirms the archive approval.

milestones.title: Read owner choices from a network member
milestones.goal: Expose the network's own owner choices to its member scripts without changing the network definition.
acceptance: context.network.choices({gate, limit}) returns the newest owner choices of the caller's network with option, time and the item data; it is read-only and limited to 1000 entries.
A test shows that another network's choices are never returned.
milestones.rollback: Remove the port; members that do not call it are unaffected.

milestones.title: Learn newsletter senders in Categorisation
milestones.goal: Route learned senders directly to the newsletter batch.
acceptance: A sender with at least two newsletter choices and no other choice is routed to mail.newsletter with a visible reason.
Any keep, invoice or reply choice for the sender cancels the rule; security alerts and protected contacts are never learned.
The run summary lists how many messages were routed by learned rules.
milestones.rollback: Re-pin the previous Categorisation script with updateMemberScript.

milestones.title: Release and verify
milestones.goal: Install the signed desktop build and observe the live network.
acceptance: Signed desktop build with paired backup; Categorisation is re-pinned without a new network revision.
Live Intake runs route mail from learned senders without a choice; the archive approval batch is unchanged.
Evidence is published as a Test Run.
milestones.rollback: Restore the paired backup and the previous member script.

approval.reference: Owner in chat: "Du hast mein Go!" on the proposal (threshold 2, exact sender addresses, archive approval unchanged).
approval.scope: Learning newsletter senders in the Delta Mind mail network. The mechanism changed from a feedback channel to a read-only choices port because feedback transitions are not allowed with routing gates; the owner-facing behaviour is unchanged.

decisions.title: Read port instead of feedback
decisions.description: Networks with routing gates reject feedback transitions, so Categorisation reads the owner choices of its own network instead.

decisions.title: Threshold and scope
decisions.description: Two consistent newsletter choices per exact sender address; any other choice cancels the rule.
decisions.reference: Owner approval in chat on October 10, 2026.

risks.title: A sender sometimes sends important mail
risks.mitigation: One keep choice cancels the rule; archiving still needs the IdP approval, so nothing is moved without the owner.
